description:
For Singapore Applicants:


Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.

  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Singapore; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
* 1 year of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end\-to\-end, 0 to 1, etc).
* Experience developing and launching products or technologies within Artificial Intelligence or Machine Learning (AI/ML).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 4 years of experience developing and launching successful products in AI/ML or related areas.
* Experience architecting agentic AI products utilizing tool\-calling, memory management, and evaluation pipelines.
* Profound experience in 'Vibe coding' via mainstream agentic tools, with willingness to dive into source code.
* Building products from the ground up in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
* Navigating complex infrastructure within large\-scale technical ecosystems and linking Google's latest AI models to applications driving growth.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Conceptualize, prototype, and define groundbreaking AI product opportunities within dynamic and ambiguous consumer environments, showcasing the forefront of Google's AI capabilities.
* Collaborate closely with DeepMind, Core ML, and other engineering teams to transform research breakthroughs into impactful product features, ensuring smooth integration and market alignment with Google's strategic partners.
* Support the entire product development process, from ideation and prototyping to launch and ongoing iteration, guaranteeing the timely delivery of exceptional AI features that resonate with users.
* Partner with Product Alliance Managers across various initiatives to cultivate captivating narratives and go\-to\-market strategies that highlight the distinctive value proposition of Google's AI solutions.

title: Senior Product Manager - Tech
description:
**Description**
 DESCRIPTION
   

  

 Amazon's GSARC team is seeking a Senior Product Manager \- Technical to drive AI\-powered operational products that transform last\-mile delivery and logistics operations across international markets. You will own end\-to\-end product strategy and execution for complex technical solutions that leverage generative AI, machine learning, and automation to improve operational efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance customer experience at scale.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for customer experiences with considerable scope and complexity — whether a complete product, a significant capability within a platform, or a customer\-facing experience requiring cross\-team coordination serving internal or external customers. You will manage products with considerable technical difficulty or complexity — products that may appear simple but are deeply technical, are part of complex systems, require significant technical detail in documentation and discussions, or require both strong technology and business domain knowledge to make the right trade\-offs.
   

  

 You will take the lead on initiatives and deliver independently, seeking direction when needed. You will influence strategic direction, customer adoption decisions, and organization priorities. Your work creates value through meaningful outcomes across customer experience, brand, business growth, and operational excellence.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Key Job Responsibilities**
* Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI/ML\-powered operational tools and platforms
* Work backwards from customer needs by generalizing requirements from diverse customer personas and use cases across your scope
* Serve as Voice of the Customer — conducting research, usability studies, and focus groups to identify best\-of\-breed benchmarks and competitive landscape
* Demonstrate deep technical curiosity — understanding core technologies within your product domain, architecture decisions, and their implications on performance, scale, and innovation
* Define technical requirements for APIs and algorithms; participate meaningfully in architecture reviews, probing technical debt implications and long\-term maintainability
* Hold engineering teams to high standards for product solutions; assess how AI capabilities are reshaping product architectures
* Leverage AI to accelerate development cycles, rapidly generating prototypes, specifications, and documentation to validate customer value propositions faster
* Balance short\-term delivery pressures with long\-term architectural integrity — recognizing when technical shortcuts create unacceptable debt and when pragmatic trade\-offs accelerate learning
* Define vision (PR/FAQ), problem statement, tenets, and strategy; own your roadmap and priorities
* Align stakeholders, make smart trade\-offs, and make decisions using sophisticated judgment when data is incomplete
* Partner with Design to craft exceptional customer experiences; ensure UX quality remains high even as feature complexity grows
* Drive cross\-functional alignment across engineering, science, operations, and business teams across multiple geographies


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

description:
**Description**
 The vision for Alexa is to be the world’s best personal assistant. Alexa Smart Properties enables enterprise customers to deploy Alexa in their managed properties like hotels, senior living homes, vacation rentals, hospitals, and more, transforming how businesses engage with their customers and streamline staff processes. We’re leveraging Generative AI to reimagine how hospitality, healthcare, senior living, and other verticals deliver magical experiences to their guests, patients, residents, and staff.
   

  

 If you’re passionate about building enterprise\-grade communication and device management solutions — while applying GenAI to solve hard, complex technical problems — then this role is for you. You will operate at the intersection of large language models, content management systems, third party integrations , and enterprise SaaS platforms to deliver delightful, scalable features for our B2B customers and their end users.
   

  

 Come join us to invent the future of how millions of enterprise end users communicate and connect through Alexa\-powered devices — and how businesses manage those experiences at scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Senior Product Manager — Technical in Alexa Smart Properties, you will own and drive the product vision and execution for our enterprise staff personas to make it easy for staff to manage their content, get real time insights, and engage with their end customers. You will own our enterprise console and integrations with third party systems. You will manage how staff manage content in our enterprise console including menus, events, promotions, alerts, and contacts. You will create features to deliver staff real time insights \- through intelligent real time events to analytics. You will also build out capabilities to track tickets, orders, and other tasks directly in our enterprise console.
   

  

 With Alexa Smart Properties, you can also manage your content and end customer engagement using a third party system such as a property management system or resident engagement system. You will manage the roadmap of integrations we develop as well as improvements to accelerate integration speed and scale.
   

  

 Across both pillars, you will use all means possible — including AI capabilities — to accelerate development cycles, enable faster learning, make better decisions, and unlock new forms of innovation. You will leverage GenAI to rapidly generate prototypes, specifications, and documentation to validate customer value propositions faster. You will deeply understand your product’s business context — market dynamics, competitive landscape, pricing strategy, and profitability drivers — and articulate how product decisions impact business outcomes.
   

  

 You will define vision (PR/FAQ), problem statements, tenets, and strategy while owning roadmap and priorities. You will influence without authority, building alignment across teams with different priorities — engineering, science, design, finance, marketing, sales, legal, and operations. You will establish key performance indicators, drive feature adoption, and measure the health of your product and business, distinguishing between output metrics such as adoption and outcome metrics such as customer satisfaction and business impact. You will create buy\-in for your vision across the Alexa organization and with external partners, and conduct or commission customer research, usability studies, and competitive analysis to identify best\-of\-breed benchmarks and understand market opportunities.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 As a Sr. PMT in Alexa Smart Properties, rarely are two days the same. You are a business owner, the voice of the customer, and the point person for partner teams across communication and device management experiences.
   

  

 On a daily basis, you will be working with enterprise customers to understand the needs of the staff persona \- including needs to manage content, engagement with end customers, and get real\-time insights. Your day could consist of writing PRFAQs and BRDs, building a prioritized roadmap, sprint planning/bug bashing, iterating on product decisions with Engineering teams, evaluating how GenAI and agentic systems can accelerate your roadmap, working with partners in business development, solution architects, legal, privacy, documentation, and more. You will think big to envision what’s next for enterprise communications, and exhibit “Learn and Be Curious” for different technologies — including emerging AI capabilities.
   

  

 You will make informed trade\-offs, build your own mockups and prototypes, define acceptance criteria, and participate in testing and validation. You’ll evaluate technical proposals for strengths and weaknesses — including extensibility, performance, and scalability — asking the right questions to identify risks before commitments are made. You’ll assess how AI capabilities can reshape product architectures, when autonomous agent patterns enhance versus complicate product design, and how to leverage GenAI to accelerate insight generation while applying critical judgment. You will use AI on a daily basis to increase your velocity and scale your impact.
   

  

 You will meet with customers to understand our core strengths and weaknesses, synthesize feedback with business and service data, and drive decisions using sophisticated judgment when data is incomplete. People will look to you to solve problems, connect them with specialists, and hold the tension between business outcomes and customer value honestly.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* Experience managing technical products or online services
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in using analytical tools, such as Tableau, Qlikview, QuickSight
* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

description:
**Description**
 Amazon is seeking a Senior Product Manager to drive the product strategy and execution for AWIPL — Amazon's only 1P retail entity for B2B in India. AWIPL exists to solve a fundamentally hard problem: the tools and playbooks that power Amazon's B2C businesses were never designed for the B2B operating model.
   

  

 This is a zero\-to\-one product role. You will not inherit a mature product with an established tech stack. You will define what needs to be built, work with stakeholders for prioritization across 20\+ cross\-functional partner teams, write the BRDs and PRFAQs that make the business case, and own delivery end\-to\-end across multiple concurrent initiatives
   

  

 AWIPL serves two distinct B2B customer segments: SSR customers (small sole proprietors and independent retailers) and CPS customers (large enterprises like Infosys procuring at scale). Each segment has different selection, pricing, fulfillment, and credit requirements, and neither is adequately served by existing Amazon B2C tooling. You will close that gap at the foundational level.
   

  

 The role carries broad scope and senior leadership visibility. You will present weekly to leadership team, align stakeholders across organizations, and operate in an environment where every product decision has a direct, measurable impact.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own the AWIPL product roadmap acros, spanning tools parity and scalable growth capabilities
* Write PRFAQs, BRDs, and technical intake documents to secure engineering capacity from partner teams including WW AB Tech, SCOT, Recommerce, FC Ops, Tax Engine, and FinOps.
* Drive delivery of in\-flight initiatives:
* Define and execute the 3YF product vision.
* Leverage AI and automation to shift AWIPL from reactive firefighting to predictive decision\-making: WBR diagnostic platforms, causal knowledge graphs, predictive OOS models, and CPS deal workflow automation eliminating 100\+ hours/month of manual coordination.
* Communicate strategy, progress, and blockers to senior leaders weekly and align partner team leadership to prioritize AWIPL's roadmap asks above competing demands.


**About The Team**
 AWIPL is Amazon India's B2B retail entity, operating at the intersection of 1P retail and enterprise B2B. We are building Amazon Business India's supply chain from the ground up — solving problems that have no off\-the\-shelf answers, no existing playbooks, and no direct WW analogues. Our customers are Indian enterprises and retailers. Our opportunity is a $1\.2T Indian retail market with only 7% e\-commerce penetration and 15MM offline retailers underserved by traditional distribution.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
* Experience working in e\-commerce / retail / supply chain / financial services business
* Experience with AI/ML technologies
* Experience influencing internal and external stakeholders
* Experience in new business or zero\-to\-one product environments
